knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson says work starts from the authorised scope and site instructions, and that a locked room on an old checklist is not entered. Cleaners do not isolate or switch off the system.
The stop-work rule requires stopping, making the area safe and telling the supervisor before resuming when the task or conditions are uncertain.
The lesson's completion criteria require evidence of accurate scope interpretation and reliable handover. Self-reports and time spent do not show that.

practicalCriteria: Learner states, for each site on a supplied roster, the location of the first aid kit, extinguisher, assembly point and incident form.
Learner identifies an unlabelled product in a supplied store, sets it aside and reports it without using it.
Learner completes a supplied shift sequence from sign-in to a verbal handover and leaves the shift records complete.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Sign-in record for the shift and sites visited
Completed shift handover checklist signed by the supervisor
Record of any defect, unlabelled product or incident found on the shift
stopWorkCriteria: Learner starts work before confirming the emergency contact and first aid location
